dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Hello, are you a tourist heading to the Grand Narukami Shrine? Come in and grab a fortune slip!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Sacred Sakura...

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: According to the legends, this Thunder Sakura is the physical manifestation of the Great Narukami's power. That's why it is named the Sacred Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: The flowers of the Sacred Sakura tree bloom all year round, and they protect the peace and serenity of Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About drawing fortune slips...

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: The people who come to the shrine are mostly looking for the archon's blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: They believe that if they get a good fortune slip, they will be blessed by the Electro Archon, and that life will be easy in the upcoming days.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: But if they get a bad slip, they can still leave the slip at the shrine in hopes for a change of fate.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: If you have any wishes, why don't you come get a slip for yourself as well?

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Huh. Well, some people do believe that the wishes won't come true if they are revealed.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Whatever wish you may have, I hope that it will be granted soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to reunite with my family.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Even the petal that drifts furthest shall one day return to the earth. The Electro Archon will watch over you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Goodbye! All the best to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Cleansing Ritual...

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Lady Yae said that you're the Traveler who completed the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: You have my thanks. Now that the Cleansing Ritual has been completed, the Sacred Sakura is now thriving more than ever before.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: The Sacred Sakura roots are connected to one another, and together they bless the land of Inazuma. You too shall be blessed as you walk upon this land.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Gendou Ringo...

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: Ah, you mean her change in outlook?

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: She certainly has been much more friendly to those coming to get fortune slips, and she's much more patient now when helping to resolve their problems.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: We certainly have her to thank for bringing in more people to get fortune slips!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Glory to the everlasting...

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: ...Forever may the Electro Archon reign.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: That's right. This is the "eternity" that the Electro Archon is pursuing. It seems like you already know something about Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Maki
dialogues.text: You can have this small floral ornament. Even though it's not formed from divine powers, it should still be able to accompany you for a long time. I wish you good luck.
